study: C2UF BIG and SLIM with the USINE provider, B/C and 10Be/9Be (SYNTHETIC Asimov, ILLUSTRATIVE inputs)

allowed_transformations: solar modulation per isotope (outside this reader)
rebin (recompute the bin integrals from the run's tables; never merge ratios)

conventions.energy_variable: kinetic_energy_per_nucleon in GeV/n: the ratio of the bin-integrated fluxes (r3 P2; equal to the ratio of their bin averages), isotopes summed at equal E/n (P3)
conventions.frame: Galactic rest frame (interstellar gas at rest)
conventions.mass_approximation: bare-nucleus masses of AME2020 (core.constants.physical) for the rigidity mapping; USINE's own kinematics inside the run

normalization.convention: ratio of two bin-integrated fluxes; the normalization cancels

phase_space.definition: USINE local interstellar flux at the observer (r = 8.3 kpc, z = 0), before solar modulation

observable.process: unmodulated local interstellar B/C from a USINE V3.5 run (Model2DKisoVc): ratio of bin integrals of 10B+11B over 12C (13C, 14C not in the network)

transport_substitutes: observer at r = 8.3 kpc, z = 0 (not fixed by the transport block); no central hole
diffusion.form 'beta^eta (R/R0)^delta with smooth breaks': not parsed; K = beta^eta K0 (Rig/R0)^delta times the break factors is fixed by the canonical fields
low break form (1 + (R_break/Rig)^((delta - delta_below)/s))^s of the plugin's 'usine' convention (transport_conventions.py; not re-read from Weinrich et al. 2020a)
reacceleration.relation 'Seo-Ptuskin 1994': momentum diffusion Kpp of USINE's shipped files (Seo-Ptuskin form)
electron-capture decay off: fully stripped nuclei (7Be) are stable (r3 P6)

cross_sections.ghost_threshold 'off: ghost nuclei and tertiary chains off on both sides': not parsed; ghost nuclei are not loaded (IsLoadGhosts false; the cumulative cross sections of USINE's chart crcharts_Zmax30_ghost97.dat) and tertiary chains are off
sources.injection species_group ['all primaries']: one slope for every primary of the network
sources.spatial 'not fixed by harmonized-v1; each code records its choice': not parsed; uniform in r up to radius_kpc in the thin disc (template CST)
gas 'uniform, n_H = 1 cm^-3': HI = 1 cm^-3, HII = H2 = 0 in the thin disc of half-thickness h; USINE's Coulomb loss acts on HII and is therefore zero
gas He_to_H_number 0.1: not used; the ILLUSTRATIVE cross sections are on hydrogen only and no helium cross section is invented (He density 0, target H)

source spectrum dQ/dE_k/n = q Rig^-2.3 (USINE POWERLAW, eta_s = 0), uniform in r up to radius_kpc in the thin disc (template CST)

parent abundances: each parent source scaled until its unmodulated local flux at E_k/n = 10 GeV/n is in the ratio C 1, O 0.9 (theory:cr-secondary-ratio parent list); USINE NormList with generated points, not data
sources.abundances 'fixed by the parent list of theory:cr-secondary-ratio': not parsed; the parent ratios above are used
tertiary chains, ghost nuclei and exotic primaries off
family 'BIG': a label of the model family, not read by the translator
free ['D0_cm2_s', 'delta', 'V_A_kms', 'V_c_kms']: one run fixes every parameter; a fit varies the free ones
